_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); pharmaceutical signals

pit_profile.why: 'is a global specialty biopharmaceutical company whose mission is to discover, develop and deliver innovative medicines that help patients prevail over serious diseases.' (FY2015 10-K, Item 7); 'We face intense competition from other manufacturers, including for both innovative medicines and lower-priced generic products.' (Item 1A heading); 'We could lose market exclusivity of a product earlier than expected.' (Item 1A heading); 'We depend on several key products for most of our revenues, cash flows and earnings.' (Item 1A heading)

BEAR.desc: EPS -46.3%/yr (worst year FY06-FY14, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +23.7%/yr (Q3 sales ex-FX + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr ex-FY15 median

BULL.desc: EPS +23.7%/yr (FY06-FY14 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +83.7%/yr (best 2-yr run FY06-FY14); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: BMY (retrospective, 2016-11-18) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.59x (82.4% downside to Bear $10 / +139.6% upside to Bull $136) | Adj composite 3.59 vs market 1.67: gap +1.92 [UNDERVALUED] | +12% above the EPP floor $51 (19x FY16E $2.67) | Conservative 2-yr case: +65.9% total (+32.9%/yr) | At 21.3x FY16E the 15% hurdle price $75 sits at or below the BASE case; U.S. revenues +36.5% in Q3 2016, forward revenues +22% (no FY16 revenue guide in numbers, Q3 2016 net sales growth ex-FX); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
